June 18,2019

Hon Scott S. Harris
Clerk, Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20543

Re:

Allen V. Cooper. No. 18-877

Dear Mr. Harris,

I represent the Petitioners in the above-captioned case, in which the Supreme Court granted 
certiorari on June 3, 2019. After conferring with counsel for the Respondents, we jointly move 
for adoption of the following modified briefing schedule for the merits briefs in this case:

•  Petitioners’ brief:
•  Respondents’ brief on the merits:

August 6, 2019 
September 20, 2019

This requested schedule reflects mutually agreed-to extensions for both parties. In 
addition, this schedule would allow for the case to be set for oral argument on any date during (or 
after) the session beginning on Monday, November 4, 2019, consistent with Rule 25.3.

Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Very truly yoms.

Derek L. Shaffer
